_readme: Town data for towns/build.js. Towns with a "page" block get a generated page; the rest are used for the town chips and 'nearby' links. Coordinates from OpenStreetMap (Oct 2026). Park notes researched Oct 2026; re-check yearly.

warehouse._note: Exact warehouse location (U.S. Census geocoder and OpenStreetMap agree). Town-page distances are straight-line x roadFactor; the delivery checker uses real driving miles.

_heroHowTo: Banner photo: every town uses defaultHero unless its "page" block has a "hero" block. Upload the photo to ERS (or any public host), paste its URL as "photo", and write "alt" describing the photo with the town name (Google reads it). Optional: "position" / "positionMobile" choose which part of the photo stays in view (CSS object-position, e.g. "30% 50%" = left-of-center; first number is left-right, second is top-bottom). "credit" adds a small photo credit (required for Creative Commons photos, e.g. Wikimedia). Only use photos you took or have the rights to.

defaultHero.alt: Bounce Buddies truck with a giant inflatable eagle in a local parade
